title: A linear subspace of dimension at least 2 with the origin removed is connected (parent step 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let H ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim H ≥ 2 (2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ H). Then H ∖ {0} is connected, i.e. nonempty and preconnected.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ H → IsConnected ((H : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0})
